in_sanskrit.name: सरङ्गदेवी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sarang means bow, and Devi is goddess. Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, takes this form to symbolize the love and devotion required for true learning.

in_hindi.name: सरङ्गदेवी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sarangi is a musical instrument used in Indian classical music. Devi means goddess. Sarangdevi could be named after this instrument, symbolizing the melodious and harmonious nature of the goddess.

in_tamil.name: சரங்கதேவி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sarangam is a musical instrument used in Carnatic music. Devi means goddess. Sarangadevi represents the divine love and melodious music that nourishes the soul.

in_telugu.name: శరఙ్గదేశి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sarangam is a musical instrument used in Carnatic music. Sarangadevi represents the divine love and artistic creativity that inspires and nourishes the soul.

in_marathi.name: Sarangdevi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the Sarang Tree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarangdevi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sarangdevi is a female deity in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as a goddess of love, beauty, and music. She is also known as the 'Lady of the Sarang Tree', and is believed to reside in the heart chakra, providing emotional balance and inner peace.
